content.user_title: Build Azure Vision Java Image Analysis Apps
content.value_statement: Java teams need reliable examples for Azure image captioning, OCR, tagging, and object detection. This skill provides SDK setup patterns, feature examples, and deployment notes for Azure AI Vision.
actual_capabilities: Shows the Maven dependency for the Azure AI Vision Image Analysis Java package.
Demonstrates synchronous and asynchronous ImageAnalysis client creation.
Provides examples for captions, dense captions, OCR, tags, objects, people, and smart crops.
Shows local file analysis and URL-based image analysis patterns.
Covers HttpResponseException handling, image requirements, and regional feature notes.
limitations: It provides SDK guidance, not a complete production application.
Users must supply their own Azure AI Vision resource, endpoint, and credentials.
Caption and dense caption features may require supported Azure regions.
It does not cover billing controls, quota planning, or privacy compliance programs.

use_cases.title: Add Image Captions
use_cases.description: Implement caption generation in a Java service using Azure AI Vision and gender-neutral caption options.

use_cases.title: Extract Document Text
use_cases.description: Use OCR examples to read text lines, words, confidence scores, and bounding polygons from uploaded images.

use_cases.title: Prepare Media Metadata
use_cases.description: Generate tags, object locations, people boxes, and smart crop regions for image catalog workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Add Basic Captioning
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a local image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to add Azure AI Vision caption generation to a Java app. Include the Maven dependency, environment variables, client setup, and a local image example.

prompt_templates.title: Extract OCR Text
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate text extraction from image files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a Java OCR method for images. Return detected lines, words, confidence scores, and bounding polygon details.

prompt_templates.title: Combine Vision Features
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced feature selection for URL analysis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to analyze an image URL with captions, tags, objects, and OCR. Include error handling and explain when to request each feature.

prompt_templates.title: Design Production Integration
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced architecture planning for a production service.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan an asynchronous Java image analysis service with DefaultAzureCredential, image validation, retries, regional checks, logging, and privacy safeguards.

output_examples.input: A developer asks how to caption a local image with Azure AI Vision in Java.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a Java-oriented setup path with the Maven dependency, environment variable names, client creation steps, and caption feature usage.

output_examples.input: A team needs OCR output from scanned receipts and wants confidence values.
output_examples.output: The skill explains how to request the READ feature and how to iterate through text blocks, lines, words, confidence scores, and bounding polygons.

output_examples.input: A media service wants thumbnails and searchable image metadata.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends smart crops, tags, objects, and people detection, then describes how to handle bounding boxes and feature availability.

best_practices: Use environment variables or managed identity for credentials, and never log secret values.
Validate image format, size, dimensions, and source URL before sending images for analysis.
Request only the visual features that each workflow needs to reduce cost and latency.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode Azure keys or service endpoints in source control.
Do not run every visual feature on every image without a clear product need.
Do not accept untrusted image URLs without validation, allowlists, and access controls.

faq.question: What Azure package does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers the com.azure:azure-ai-vision-imageanalysis Java package for Azure AI Vision Image Analysis.

faq.question: Can it help with OCR?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows how to use the READ feature and process text blocks, lines, words, and confidence scores.

faq.question: Does it support asynchronous analysis?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes an ImageAnalysisAsyncClient pattern with subscription handlers for results, errors, and completion.

faq.question: Does it require an Azure key?
faq.answer: The examples support API key credentials and DefaultAzureCredential. Users must provide their own Azure resource access.

faq.question: Can it analyze image URLs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes analyzeFromUrl examples for captions, objects, tags, people, smart crops, and dense captions.

faq.question: What should users check before deployment?
faq.answer: Users should check image limits, supported formats, regional feature availability, credential handling, and service error handling.
